verdict.rationale: Linear's Initiatives feature (assigning a team to lead an initiative, priority, proposed/canceled statuses, private teams for confidential large launches) shows cross-team coordination and alignment on big efforts, and project subscriptions/notifications support tracking progress across teams. However, the evidence pack never mentions explicit issue-level dependency tracking (e.g., blocking/blocked-by relations) or dependency visualization across teams, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit cross-issue/project dependency linking and visualization, dependency-aware timeline/roadmap views, independent corroboration of large-launch coordination use cases.
